observation_summary: The SimplexSolver was entering an infinite loop (cycling) during the optimization process, causing the iteration count to exceed the maximum limit and throwing a MaxCountExceededException.
reasoning_summary: The fix introduces new conditional logic (guards) to handle degeneracy and prevent cycling in the Simplex algorithm. Specifically, it adds checks for artificial variables and a heuristic based on iteration count to select the pivot row more effectively. Since this modifies the core procedural logic of the Simplex iteration strategy to prevent infinite loops, it is classified as an Algorithm/Method defect.
evidence_used: The fix adds conditional checks (if statements) around the pivot row selection logic.
The fix implements a heuristic to prevent cycling by checking the current iteration count against the maximum.
The fix adds logic to handle artificial variables during the pivot row selection process.
The stack trace shows the failure is due to exceeding the maximum iteration count, which is a symptom of an infinite loop in the algorithm.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the fix adds 'if' statements, these are not simple parameter validation guards; they are integral parts of the algorithmic strategy to prevent cycling and handle degeneracy in the Simplex method.
